For a planned PTO request, the employee must first check their projected PTO balance and the team calendar, then submit the requested dates, hours, and any coverage notes through the People Portal. The request is automatically routed to the employee’s direct manager. The manager has up to **three business days** to approve or deny the request, based on coverage, workload, and equitable scheduling. Once approved, the portal notifies the employee and updates the projected balance; the actual PTO is deducted when the absence is processed. This is the standard notice and manager‑approval workflow for planned PTO.

Sources: HR-002 — Paid Time Off Policy, section Paid Time Off Policy > 4. Using PTO > 4.4 Approval workflow; HR-006 — Leave of Absence Policy, section Leave of Absence Policy > 2. Requesting leave > 2.2 Unexpected leave; HR-001 — Employee Handbook, section Employee Handbook > 4. Work schedules and attendance > 4.2 Attendance and availability; HR-006 — Leave of Absence Policy, section Leave of Absence Policy > 3. Leave categories > 3.4 Jury duty and military service; HR-002 — Paid Time Off Policy, section Paid Time Off Policy > 8. Separation and payout > 8.4 PTO during notice periods

Policy search excerpts are candidate evidence, not an overall eligibility or compliance determination.
